question: Where is the world's highest waterfall, the 'Angel falls', located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venezuela.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Venezuela's Angel Falls**, also known as **Kerepakupai Mer**, or** "waterfall of the deepest place,"** which is said to drop **979 meters**, is the **tallest or highest waterfall **in the world.
 
• **Surveyor Perry Lowrey** took measurements of the waterfall in **1949** as part of an expedition supported by **National Geographic **and headed by Ruth Robertson.
 
• The** single uninterrupted drop of 2648 feet **is also the world's highest.
 
• **Two world records** are held by Angel Falls: The waterfall with the largest height overall, as well as the one with the biggest uninterrupted drop.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Venezuela is a nation on** South America's northern coast** with a variety of natural features. The **petroleum sector, biodiversity**, and stunning natural attractions like** Angel Falls** are all well-known for Venezuela.
